name: A Key to the Throne Room

text.offer: Help? Yes, I could use some help. A certain someone, or rather something, is running wild around here. Go and kill Vozun for me, and I'll give you the key to Castle Victoria's throne room.
text.progress: Return to Kailor once it's done.
text.complete: Finally. Good job getting rid of them! Here is the key to the throne room.

steps.brief: Got him? Great. He has a brother: find him as well. Go and kill Croco for me.
Good, you're quite the warrior! Find Dulahan and slay him!
